rationale: This is essentially the well-known operating profitability anomaly (Novy-Marx/Fama-French RMW) masked to the R&D-intensive subsample, and the masking is mechanically damaging because all non-R&D firms (including every non-reporter, coerced to zero) collapse to a signal value of exactly 0 that sits in the middle of the industry-adjusted profitability distribution, muddling both the FMB slope and the portfolio legs.

The interaction of intangible-capitalized profitability (Peters-Taylor style) with accumulated intangible intensity is economically coherent and not a direct rediscovery, though the multiplicative rank form will be dominated by the intensity leg and will floor all zero-R&D/zero-advertising firms at a common value, so a demeaned or double-sorted version should be tested alongside it.

Cash profitability and R&D increases are each known effects, but their conditional combination ("can the firm self-fund the intangible ramp?") is a defensible and non-trivial interaction; the main weakness is the large tie mass at TREND=0 for non-R&D firms, which will make the low-signal leg compositionally arbitrary.

The expression is internally inconsistent with the hypothesis and numerically unsafe — dividing sales growth by R&D intensity makes the signal explode for firms with near-zero or zero R&D (division by zero after COALESCE), so it mechanically rewards the least R&D-intensive growers rather than the "R&D-intensive firms converting research into sales" the hypothesis describes.

Because xad is missing for the majority of Compustat firms and is coerced to zero, the MIN operator pins a huge mass of firms at the identical minimum rank, so the signal degenerates into little more than advertising-intensity availability (a known effect) with an arbitrarily composed short leg.

"Intangible share of SG&A" as a quality discriminator on overhead-scaled profitability is a genuinely fresh angle rather than a repackaged published anomaly, but both components share a small, occasionally near-zero xsga denominator (which in Compustat frequently already subsumes xrd), so the ratio instability and mechanical overlap need to be checked before the result is believed.
